mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates on equity cash flows and boosting future stock prices, leading to positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20d returns in easing periods not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 7.5%, it signals strengthening labor markets, fostering confidence and positive equity valuations, resulting in positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns not positive when UNRATE crosses below 7.5%, with t-test p > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in economic demand (GDPC1) and falling federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) create a dual accommodative signal, enhancing growth prospects and equity returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive when GDPC1 rises and FEDFUNDS falls, with IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, rising supply (INDPRO) alongside controlled inflation (CPIAUCSL) suggests peak growth near, prompting positive forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, 20d returns not positive when INDPRO rises and CPIAUCSL stable, IC < 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in labor employment (PAYEMS) above 5,000 monthly signals labor market strength, boosting growth expectations and equity values, leading to positive 5-day returns.
failure_condition: 5d returns not positive when PAYEMS crosses 5,000, IC < 0.03 over 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) alongside falling demand (GDPC1) signal recessionary pressures, lowering growth expectations and equity returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60d returns not negative when FEDFUNDS rises and GDPC1 falls, IC < 0.03 over 2 years.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rise in demand (HOUST) and falling rates (FEDFUNDS) create a strong growth signal, driving positive equity returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: 5d returns not positive when HOUST rises and FEDFUNDS falls, IC < 0.03 over 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, rising rates (FEDFUNDS) with stable inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals higher interest rates, dampening growth and equity returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60d returns not negative in tightening cycle, IC < 0.03 over 3 years.
